plaatsen.tekst: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died.
And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;
The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.
Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?

For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle

Thus saith God the LORD, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk
For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left
And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.

And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came
The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
